lead: A progress bar. The role and `aria-valuenow` come from Base UI's Progress; how the bar is drawn is up to the theme style.

circle.title: Circle and Dashboard
circle.description: A ring and a gauge. Progress is a `stroke-dasharray`, so the arc moves smoothly when the value changes; with indeterminate progress a short arc spins around.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `progress.css`. The looping animation of indeterminate progress lives in the theme style too: the component only writes `data-indeterminate`.
styling.circle: The ring's container and SVG (`aria-hidden`; accessibility is on `progress`); `data-type=circle|dashboard`
styling.circleParts: Base circle, indicator circle (progress is `--pc-value`, 0–100, in `stroke-dasharray`) and the number in the middle of the ring
styling.track: Track and indicator; Base UI writes the width inline
styling.states: Written on `progress` and the indicator; theme styles draw each state with them
